name: ChromaClock Wide
author: airbornetrooper82573
description: Native-width animated clock for five-panel LEDMatrix displays

widgets.name: chromaclock-live-preview
widgets.description: Live five-panel browser preview in plugin settings

versions.notes: Initial release: a native-width animated clock with 28 styles (neon, prism, starfield, matrix, fire, aurora, pong, tetris, ...), style cycling or a pinned preview style, date, seconds, 12/24-hour, timezone, palette, glow and brightness, plus a live browser preview in the plugin settings. Inspired by alejoar's ChromaClock; no code or styles copied. Designed on 320x32 (five 64x32 panels) and reads the real panel size.
